I didn't edit `0007_add_customers.sql`. Instead I added `migrations/0008_fix_customers_email.sql`, which contains:

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

A project memory says files in `migrations/` are applied in production and must never be edited. The fix goes in a new numbered file instead. Editing 0007 would change nothing in databases that have already run it, and the file would no longer match what was applied. Your old job's edit-until-release approach doesn't fit here.

`emial` appears nowhere else in the repo, so nothing else needs changing. I haven't run the migration.

If 0007 has never been applied anywhere, tell me and I'll edit it directly. I'd also drop the 0008 file in that case.
